headline: MTN Nigeria Names Ibrahim Dikko and Fabian Ajogwu to Board
summary: MTN Nigeria Communications appointed Ibrahim Dikko, Fabian Ajogwu, and three other directors to its board, with appointments taking effect December 1, 2026.
why: MTN Nigeria is the country's largest telecommunications provider by subscriber count and plays a vital role in West Africa's mobile connectivity and fintech markets.

impacts.name: MTN Nigeria
impacts.why: The company appointed five new members to its board of directors.
